# Zolto — Multi-Tenant POS + E-Commerce Platform for Artisan Sellers

Zolto is an open-source, self-hosted platform for independent makers, artisans, and small boutiques to run modern online stores and in-person point-of-sale systems. Built from first-hand experience operating a jewelry store in Zurich.

## What Zolto Does

Zolto is a complete business platform for artisan sellers with:

- **Online Store**: Product catalogs, shopping cart, secure checkout with Stripe Cards & TWINT (Switzerland)
- **POS System**: iOS/Android Tap to Pay, cash register, TWINT QR payments
- **AI Tools**: Bulk product creation from photos, Discord bot for inventory sync
- **Admin Dashboard**: Real-time inventory, sales analytics, staff management, customer insights
- **Multi-Tenant**: Each seller gets their own branded storefront at custom domain or subdomain
- **Open Source**: Self-hosted on your own infrastructure (Docker, Caddy, MySQL)

## Key Features

- **Payment Options**: Stripe integration (cards worldwide), native TWINT support (Swiss payments)
- **Inventory Management**: Real-time sync between online store and POS
- **Analytics**: Sales tracking, customer behavior, popular products
- **Customizable**: White-label, custom branding, domain ownership
- **Mobile First**: Native iOS & Android apps for POS, responsive web store
- **Data Ownership**: All data stays on your infrastructure
- **AI-Powered**: Auto-generate product descriptions and photos from uploads
- **Discord Integration**: Automated inventory alerts and order notifications

## Who It's For

- Jewelry designers & craftspeople
- Boutique owners
- Artisan makers (ceramics, textiles, crafts)
- Small retail businesses
- Independent creators who want control over their data & branding

## Technology Stack

- **Frontend**: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, TypeScript
- **Backend**: Express.js, tRPC 11, Drizzle ORM
- **Database**: MySQL
- **Infrastructure**: Docker, Caddy, self-hosted
- **Mobile**: React Native (iOS/Android)
- **Payments**: Stripe API, TWINT integration

## Pricing

Zolto is offered as:
- **Self-Hosted**: Deploy on your own server (free/open-source)
- **Managed Hosting**: Zolto-hosted option with automatic updates and support

Visit https://zolto.ch/pricing for current options.

## Getting Started

1. Visit https://zolto.ch/signup to create your seller account
2. Set up your store branding and products
3. Choose payment methods (Stripe, TWINT, cash)
4. Deploy POS app to your phone or use web checkout
5. Start selling

For detailed setup guides, see https://zolto.ch/docs

## Philosophy

Zolto is built on the belief that artisan sellers deserve modern tools that:
- Respect data ownership (self-hosted)
- Support multiple payment methods (especially local ones like TWINT)
- Work offline and online seamlessly
- Are designed by people who actually run stores, not just theoretically

Every feature is informed by real-world use at Kalakosh, our jewelry store in Zurich.
